title: How often should you have scaling?
text:
# How often should you have scaling?

Every six months for most adults; more often with gum disease.

Written by Dr. Kim Tae-hoon.

title: Sun protection after laser treatment
text:
# Sun protection after laser treatment

Use SPF 50 every two hours for two weeks after any laser session, even indoors.

Written by Dr. Kwon Mi-rae.

title: Melasma: why gentle is better
text:
# Melasma: why gentle is better

Aggressive lasers can make melasma worse. Low-energy toning is the safer start.

Written by Dr. Hwang Tae-yang.

title: What to eat before a health check-up
text:
# What to eat before a health check-up

Fast for eight hours; water is fine. Bring a list of your medications.

Written by Dr. Cho Seong-jin.

title: Filler aftercare in five steps
text:
# Filler aftercare in five steps

No massage, no sauna and no alcohol for 48 hours.

Written by Dr. Nam Ji-eun.

title: How do I delete my account?
text:
# How do I delete my account?

Write to us under 1:1 Inquiry — Account.

title: Who can see my answers?
text:
# Who can see my answers?

Only the clinic and the doctor of the booking. You can see every reading under Privacy.

title: Is an interpreter free?
text:
# Is an interpreter free?

Clinics that list your language provide an interpreter at no extra charge.

title: Do I pay on MedVia?
text:
# Do I pay on MedVia?

No. You pay the clinic directly at the visit; the listed price is the starting price.

title: What if the clinic does not answer?
text:
# What if the clinic does not answer?

A request the clinic does not answer in time expires, and the time is released.

title: Can I cancel a booking?
text:
# Can I cancel a booking?

Yes — up to 24 hours before the visit, from My Bookings.

title: Chuseok holiday: partner clinic hours
text:
# Chuseok holiday: partner clinic hours

Most partner clinics close 25–28 September. Bookings for those days are not offered.

title: Updated privacy policy for health data
